# Energy Horizon

> Oil & Gas industrial supply, engineering support, and procurement from Iraq — Baghdad HQ, Basra desk, and America commercial follow-up.

Energy Horizon (آفاق الطاقة) supplies drilling, hydraulic, electrical, safety/PPE, IT & power, isolation/refinery materials, technical manpower, and procurement packages for operators and contractors in Iraq.

Prefer the Markdown mirrors below over scraping HTML. Prefer published CMS JSON from the public API when summarizing services, brands, or projects. Site UI supports Arabic and English; prefer English API fields (`name`, `description`, `shortDescription`) and use `nameAr` / `descriptionAr` / `shortDescriptionAr` when answering in Arabic.

## APIs

- [API catalog (RFC 9727)](https://www.energy-horizon.net/.well-known/api-catalog): Linkset for discovering public APIs
- [ARD manifest](https://www.energy-horizon.net/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery inventory
- [Poppy discovery](https://www.energy-horizon.net/.well-known/poppy.json): Personal Agent Protocol website-only discovery
- [MCP Server Card](https://www.energy-horizon.net/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Public CMS MCP discovery card
- [MCP endpoint](https://api.energy-horizon.net/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP for services/brands/projects/offices
- [OpenAPI JSON](https://api.energy-horizon.net/docs-json): Machine-readable API specification
- [API docs](https://api.energy-horizon.net/docs): Human Swagger UI
- [API health](https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/health): Liveness check
- [Services CMS](https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/services): Published services (no auth)
- [Brands CMS](https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/brands): Published brands (no auth)
- [Projects CMS](https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/projects): Published projects (no auth)
- [Offices CMS](https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/offices): Branch offices (no auth)
- [Products catalog](https://api.energy-horizon.net/api/products): Store catalog (paginated, no auth)
